{{Top|leg}}
'''Helrossi-principal Octratics''' was a form of mathematics developed by the [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] to calculate [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps and travel routes.

==History==
The equations found by using this form were instrumental during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], they enabled [[Wavecrest-class frigate|Givin warships]] and other [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to navigate their own artificial maze created throughout the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], following the [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|Battle of Duro]].
